use serde_json::Value;

pub fn solve(input: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    for row in input.as_array() {
        let mut row_sum = 0;
        for num in row.as_array() {
            row_sum += num.as_i64().unwrap();
        }
        result.push(row_sum);
    }
    serde_json::Value::Array(result)
}
